title: Trials season 4: What’s on the horizon
body:
# Trials Season 4: What's on the Horizon

# **ARE YOU READY TO FACE THE TRIALS, RAIDER?**

You have put in serious effort gathering essential resources, thinning out ARC numbers, and investigating every odd Topside weather pattern you could find. Your efforts have paid off, and you have some rewards to show for it.

With Season 3 wrapping up on April 28, a range of colors and toggles for the Torque Set will unlock based on where you land in the final standings:

* Rookie II - Torque Set Orange Color

* Tryhard I - Jacket Outfit Variant

* Tryhard III - Headgear Outfit Variant

* Wildcard II - Shoulder pad Outfit Variant

* Daredevil I - Torque Set Yellow/Grey Color

* Hotshot - Torque Set Red Color

Tear through the Rust Belt sporting your new gear and remind the ARC what adrenaline can do. And while you're at it, swing by and grab Scrappy some olives.

# CHANGES TO THE TRIALS

This season brings a number of adjustments, all aimed at making sure every Raider gets an equal shot at tackling a wide range of engaging objectives.

## **TRIALS S4 STARTS EARLIER**

Trials Season 4 begins on **April 29**, just one day after Riven Tides goes live.

In the past, Trials paused during the Expedition window. That restriction is gone now, so you can start building your rank while you're still exploring the forgotten shoreline.

## **MAJOR MAP CONDITIONS NO LONGER AWARD 2X POINTS**

Double progress for playing under major Map Conditions has been removed. This means players can take on Trials using whichever map suits them best.

## **TRIALS WILL NO LONGER BE TIED TO SPECIFIC MAP CONDITIONS**

Certain Trials, such as 'Disarm Mines' or 'Get Hit By Lightning,' used to require a particular Map Condition, which shut some players out of a fair opportunity to compete. Since everyone deserves equal footing in the Rust Belt, Season 4's Trial challenges no longer require a specific Map Condition to make progress.

## **NEW TRIALS CHALLENGES**

The message came through clearly - Trials challenges needed more variety, and Season 4 aims to answer that.

Without giving too much away, players can look forward to fresh objectives across the coming season, including melee combat challenges, tasks that reward using particular gadgets or grenades, and searches through some unusual containers.

## **TRIALS GOING FORWARD**

Plenty of feedback has come in about Trials, and a lot of it points to frustration - whether that's squad size creating unfair advantages or concerns about the leaderboards' competitive integrity.

Work is underway to figure out how Trials can be improved and developed over the long run, so it consistently delivers the kind of competitive experience players are looking for.

Season 4 marks the first step toward letting every player join in without being boxed in by scheduling constraints, and feedback will continue to shape the system as the season unfolds.

Thank you, Raiders, for sharing your thoughts - they matter in shaping where Trials goes from here.

# TRIALS SEASON 4 REWARD

The enigmatic resort found in Riven Tides is in need of scouts willing to uncover what it's hiding. Take part in Trials Season 4 to earn the **Blindspot Outfit**, kitted out with gear fit for the beach.

Reach Tryhard I rank to unlock the base outfit, then keep progressing through the season to unlock additional toggles. That life vest might just prove useful during your time exploring the coast. Just remember - no running by the pool.

Raiders who climb all the way to the prestigious ranks of Hotshot and Cantina Legend will earn alternate colors for the Blindspot Set, a clear sign to all of Speranza that they stand above the rest.

There's also a new backpack color, a backpack charm, and an attachment up for grabs as your badge progresses. And for those determined Raiders who reach Daredevil rank, a stylish reward awaits - the new River Dance emote.

A brand new season of stories is on the way, Raiders. See you along the coast.
